events.title: European Shares Seen Tad Higher At Open
events.description: European stocks are seen opening a tad higher on Monday ahead of key U.S. inflation data and earnings from major AI companies, including CoreWeave, Cisco and Applied Materials, due later in the week.

events.title: Nvidia Probes Reports Of China Spying Effort Targeting CEO Jensen Huang; Shares Down
events.description: AI chip major Nvidia Corp.'s Board of Directors has initiated an independent investigation over recent media report against founder and CEO Jensen Huang being the target of a foreign intelligence effort. The probe comes after he confirmed having an affair with a Chinese woman named Alice Huang, or Huang Le, accused of working for Chinese intelligence.

events.title: Indian Shares Subdued After Last Week's Strong Rally
events.description: Indian shares were a tad lower in lackluster trade on Monday after last week's strong rally.

events.title: Australian Market Modestly Higher In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is modestly higher in mid-market trading on Monday after opening in the green and slipping in to the red in most of the morning session, reversing some of the losses in the previous session, following the mixed cues from Wall Street on Friday. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is moving well above the 9,000.00 mark, with gains in mining and energy stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mostly Higher
events.description: Asian markets are mostly higher on Monday, following the mixed cues from Wall Street on Friday, boosted by strong gains in Taiwan, Japan and South Korea amid a rebound in semiconductor stocks following the sell-off last week. Some traders are also looking to buy stocks at a bargain following the recent weakness. Markets also keep an eye on the peace talks to end hostilities in the Middle East.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Opening On Muted Note
events.description: Indian shares are seen opening on a muted note on Monday, tracking mixed cues from global markets as strong U.S. jobs data reinforced bets of a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike in December.

events.title: Thai Stock Market May Find Traction On Monday
events.description: The Thai stock market has finished lower in two straight sessions, plunging more than 35 points or 2.3 percent along the way. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,465-point plateau although it's due for a rebound on Monday.

events.title: Japanese Market Sharply Higher
events.description: The Japanese stock market is sharply higher on Monday, snapping a four-session losing streak, following the mixed cues from Wall Street on Friday. The Nikkei 225 is moving above the 58,850 level, with gains across most sectors led by financial and technology stocks.

events.title: China Consumer Prices Flat In September
events.description: Overall consumer prices in China were flat on a seasonally adjusted monthly basis in September, the National Bureau of Statistics said on Monday.

events.title: Indonesia Stock Market May Extend Winning Streak
events.description: The Indonesia stock market has moved higher in three straight sessions, advancing almost 150 points or 3 percent along the way. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 5,050-point plateau and it may add to its winnings on Monday.

events.title: Australian Markets Modestly Lower
events.description: The Australian stock market is modestly lower on Monday, extending the losses in the previous session, following the mixed cues from Wall Street on Friday. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is falling below the 9,000.00 mark, with weakness in financial stocks partially offset by gains in mining and energy stocks.

events.title: Australia Building Consents Climb 5.1% In September
events.description: The total number of building permits issued in Australia was up a seasonally adjusted 5.1 percent on month in September, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Monday - coming in at 17,948.

events.title: Hong Kong Stock Market May Reverse Friday's Losses
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market on Friday wrote a finish to the five-day winning streak in which it had surged more than 1,825 points or 7.8 percent. The Hang Seng now sits just above the 24,480-point plateau although it may move back to the upside again on Monday.
